name: SEA 96th Annual Meeting
deadline_note: Paper and session submissions were due Wednesday, April 1, 2026. Call closed.
submission_requirements: Paper abstract (max. 1,000 characters, about 250 words) with optional PDF attachment, via the SEA MeetingSavvy submissions portal
submission_fee: USD 35 per individual paper submission (non-refundable); waived for papers within a complete session proposal
registration_fee: Pre-registration: USD 275 professional members / USD 355 professional non-members / USD 60 student members / USD 105 student non-members; rates increase by USD 50 after Nov 6, 2026
membership_required: No membership requirement stated in the last call
